hypothesis: A fixed incoming excitatory Core weight budget makes experience-dependent weight differences useful for action-effect prediction.

fixed.rate_gain: M9 unscaled reference-network gain for the seed, identical in both conditions
fixed.initial_state: Same nodes, edges, weights, positions, polarities, delays and random streams within seed; no initial normalization

competition.pool: Initially enabled, plastic Core-to-Core synapses with excitatory presynaptic neuron, grouped by postsynaptic neuron; fixed IDs
competition.budget: Per-pool f64 sum of initial f32 weights after Core scaling; independent of mapping, arm, labels and outcomes
competition.trigger: Once per event timestamp and target pool with an actual STDP weight mutation, after all pre/post hooks and before spike propagation
competition.order: Ascending target neuron ID, then ascending synapse ID; never normalize between individual same-timestamp STDP hooks
competition.projection: For positive tentative weights v_i, solve sum(min(2, lambda*v_i))=B when B<=2*positive_count; zero weights stay zero. When B>2*positive_count, set positives to 2 and distribute the residual uniformly to zero weights. An all-zero pool receives B/pool_size.
competition.numeric_policy: Solve active-set proportional rescaling in f64, cast to f32, then correct residual in ascending synapse ID within 0..2; deterministic, no random tie breaking
competition.invalid_state: Abort on nonfinite weights, infeasible budget, changed pool membership, bound violation or residual above tolerance; never silently clamp or skip a failed pool
competition.freeze: Gated by learning and competition flags; off in all evaluation/calibration/rest/reset branches and frozen arms
competition.in_flight: Existing queued arrivals retain emission amplitudes; new emissions use normalized weights

evaluation.replay: Independent exact replay per action/endpoint/intervention; calibration on separate branch; fixed checkpoint count decoder within each trained model
evaluation.reset_timing: After independent rest if any, before the 50000us neutral baseline; same as M9-v2, not M10-E
evaluation.reset_scope: Restore condition-specific initial weights only; preserve neuron state, traces, time and pending arrivals; no normalization after reset

inference.unit: paired seed; two action probes and both mappings are not independent seed replicates
inference.family: Two condition-specific learning claims times two primary endpoints; competition claim also requires benefit over reference
inference.sign_test: Exact paired sign test, ties omitted; no nonzero differences gives p=1

bootstrap.pairing: Resample whole seeds jointly across conditions, arms, mappings and endpoints

inference.required_contrast: Mean difference >0, descriptive bootstrap lower95 >0 and one-sided exact paired sign p<=0.0125; all required contrasts conjunctive

learning_per_condition_endpoint.visual: Mean paired-arm visual decodability >=0.8 separately in each mapping
learning_per_condition_endpoint.accuracy: Paired count balanced accuracy exceeds 0.5 and each of before/aged_frozen/scrambled separately in each mapping
learning_per_condition_endpoint.mapping: Paired flip_rate and dual_correct_rate each exceed every control arm
learning_per_condition_endpoint.causality: Paired sham accuracy exceeds restore_all_plastic separately in both mappings

competition_benefit_per_endpoint.requires: Competition learning criteria at this endpoint
competition_benefit_per_endpoint.raw_accuracy: Competition paired accuracy exceeds reference paired accuracy separately in both mappings
competition_benefit_per_endpoint.learning_margin: For each control and mapping, (competition paired-control) exceeds (reference paired-control)
competition_benefit_per_endpoint.core_causality: Competition paired sham accuracy exceeds restore_core separately in both mappings

inference.retained_competition_success: All competition benefit and learning requirements pass at BOTH primary endpoints; no success from only the better endpoint
inference.reference_claim: Reference learning can be reported per endpoint independently; it does not establish competition benefit

execution_contract.tuning: No parameter, budget, seed, decoder, gate or endpoint selection from pilot/confirmation outcomes; changes require versioned protocol and new unused confirmation seeds
execution_contract.stage_gate: Technical smoke then pilot, then unchanged confirmation if technical audits pass; pilot quality does not select cases or seeds
execution_contract.failed_runs: Infrastructure failures may resume identical jobs. Neural instability is reported, not replaced by a new seed. Missing/invalid records prevent a complete confirmatory claim.
execution_contract.archives: Write manifest and all effective configurations before execution; record protocol hash and source/build identity; completed raw records immutable
execution_contract.stop: One pilot and one 20-seed confirmation; no automatic extra seed batches or follow-up M10 diagnostics
execution_contract.selection: Fixed comparison; no S1/S2/S3 search or held-out-driven selection
